profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer - AI/ML
profile.jobTitle: Staff Software Engineer - SDKs and AI
profile.summary:
Multi-faceted technology leader/software architect with 18 years of software engineering experience specializing leading technical teams on Mobile, ML/AI, and Web projects.

I love building solutions and teams.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer - SDKs and AI
positions.description: Lead AI efforts for the Libraries team and work on the mobile SDKs for segment CDP.
positions.insights: Skills: Artificial Intelligence (AI) · OpenAI API · Machine Learning · Mobile Applications · Kotlin · Swift (Programming Language) · Reverse Engineering

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Team lead for the team building microservices for managing our satellite communication devices. 

* Design and Developed multiple microservices in Angular, Typescript, Nodejs, Postgres and AWS ahead of key deadlines for product launch.
* Design and Developed several features and fixes for a legacy EmberJs,  C# ASP .Net, SQL Server system after having to get quickly upto speed.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Technical Requirements · Root Cause

positions.title: Senior Software Application Architect
positions.description:
One of two Architects for the Surface Duo Android device. Responsible for improving first-party applications and providing direction going forward, and for the UX Model Shop. 

* Reviewed first-party apps (Camera App,  Tips)  for performance, bugs, and access in Java. 
* Designed and Developed Android Apps and Services as part of the UX Model Shop in Java and Kotlin.
* Managed the UX Model Shop team to design, develop, and deliver 7 projects in 6 months with 2 making it into future official releases of the Surface Duo.
* Designed several guidelines for the first-party apps including Accessibility and Security guides.
positions.insights: Skills: Optimizing Performance · Technical Requirements · Root Cause · Kotlin

positions.title: Architect & Android Team Lead
positions.description:
Architect and Team Lead for preloaded Android app that is preloaded on over 150 million tier-1 carrier handsets. 

In this role I drive design, development, and provide technical direction for our product and interact with several groups including various non-technical groups to discuss strategy and direction. 

Highlights:
* Hybrid App Development (WebView)
* Manage Android, OEM, and Carrier fragmentation.
* Project management and Roadmap definition.
* Partner and client facing.

Technology:
* Android, Java, Javascript, CSS

positions.title: Android Developer
positions.description:
Building a platform that can be used to build hybrid Android applications. Our application exposes Android APIs and our custom APIs to a WebView that is used to host HTML/Javascript applications that we also develop in house.

Lots of experience dealing with:

* Android APIs (Service, ContentProvider, BroadcastReceiver, Activity, Wakelock, WebView, etc.)
* Android Fragmentation and Carrier Specific version of Android.
* Leading multiple teams/projects

positions.title: Android Developer
positions.description:
Android contractor for a consulting firm working on the Fluke Connect application.

Highlights:
* Android, Java, Sqlite
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Requirements · Root Cause · OkHttp

positions.title: Software Engineer & Team Lead
positions.description:
Full stack lead of a small engineering team of 4  at a Startup working on automated conversion rate optimization software and specific customer implementations.

Highlights:

* Mentoring Junior developers
* Backend server management (AWS Linux and MySQL)
